category: 组合数学 / 计数组合
literal_source_claim_en: The recurrence relation for binomial coefficients.
statement_blocker: The catalog gives only a recurrence-family gloss. It fixes no formula, binomial-coefficient definition, ordered row/column binders, valid-index domain, zero-extension convention, side conditions, historical or primary source, boundary cases, or relationship between predecessor and successor encodings. DLMF 26.3.5 states the predecessor formula for m >= n >= 1, while pinned mathlib's Nat.choose_succ_succ is total on all natural indices through the zero convention. Selecting either domain as canonical before independent source review would broaden, narrow, or substitute proposition-changing mathematics.
target_decision: preserve the conventional Pascal-recurrence family while deferring the source-restricted-versus-zero-extended target choice and every checked transport to the dependent statement phase
domain_and_universes: Expected natural-number row and column indices and natural-valued binomial coefficients; exact valid-index hypotheses versus a total zero-extended Nat.choose domain remain open. No nontrivial universe parameters are expected, but the exact Lean expression and imports are not frozen.
conclusion: Open choice between the source-oriented recurrence C(m,n) = C(m-1,n) + C(m-1,n-1) under m >= n >= 1 and a source-approved all-natural zero-extended successor encoding.
degenerate_case_status: No case is excluded before target selection; row zero, column zero, the diagonal, the first and later out-of-range columns, and predecessor subtraction at zero must be explicitly dispositioned and mutation-tested.
